data-page-href="/en/plugins/components" data-page-title="Add components to a plugin" id="content"><span data-as="p">A Claude Code plugin is built from components, such as skills, agents, hooks, and MCP servers. Each component has a default folder in the plugin, an optional manifest key in <code>.claude-plugin/plugin.json</code> that replaces or adds to that folder, and a name the user sees. For each key’s full field table, see the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/plugins/manifest-reference#fields">manifest reference</a>.</span>
<span data-as="p">Use this page to add a component to a plugin that already loads.</span>
<span data-as="p">After you add a component, run <code>/reload-plugins</code> in a running session or start a new one so Claude Code loads it. To check the component’s file before loading it, run <a class="link" href="/docs/en/plugins/cli-reference#plugin-validate"><code>claude plugin validate .</code></a> in your shell from the plugin directory.</span>
<div aria-label="Note" class="callout my-4 px-5 py-4 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl flex gap-3 border border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 dark:border-blue-900 dark:bg-blue-600/20" data-callout-type="note" role="note"><div class="mt-0.5 w-4" data-component-part="callout-icon"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-4 text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1.5" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path clip-rule="evenodd" d="M 9 1.6714 C 13.0371 1.6714 16.3286 4.9629 16.3286 9 C 16.3286 13.0371 13.0371 16.3286 9 16.3286 C 7.0574 16.3252 5.1953 15.552 3.8217 14.1783 C 2.448 12.8047 1.6748 10.9426 1.6714 9 C 1.6714 4.9629 4.9629 1.6714 9 1.6714 Z M 9 0 C 4.0371 0 0 4.0371 0 9 C 0 13.9629 4.0371 18 9 18 C 13.9629 18 18 13.9629 18 9 C 18 4.0371 13.9629 0 9 0 Z M 10.2857 3.8571 H 7.7143 V 10.2857 H 10.2857 V 3.8571 Z M 10.2857 11.5714 H 7.7143 V 14.1429 H 10.2857 V 11.5714 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-rule="evenodd" stroke="none"></path></svg></div><div class="text-sm prose dark:prose-invert min-w-0 w-full [&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-light dark:[&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-dark [&amp;_code]:text-current! [&amp;_kbd]:text-current! [&amp;_a]:text-current! [&amp;_a]:border-current [&amp;_strong]:text-current! text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300" data-component-part="callout-content"><span data-as="p">These cases are covered on other pages:</span><ul>
<li><strong>Building your first plugin</strong>: start with <a class="link" href="/docs/en/plugins/create">Create a plugin</a></li>
<li><strong>Installing someone else’s plugin</strong>: see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/plugins/install">Install plugins</a></li>
<li><strong>Your plugin’s users are on claude.ai or in Cowork</strong>: a different set of components loads there. See <a class="link" href="https://claude.com/docs/plugins/build" rel="noreferrer" target="_blank">Plugin structure and testing</a> and the <a class="link" href="https://claude.com/docs/plugins/platform-support#compare-component-support-by-app" rel="noreferrer" target="_blank">component support table</a></li>
</ul></div></div>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="explore-the-plugin-directory"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#explore-the-plugin-directory">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Explore the plugin directory</span></h2><aside class="mdx-live-widget">
<p class="mdx-live-widget-label">Interactive explorer</p>
<p>This directory tree is interactive on the original page and cannot run inside an EPUB. Open it here: <a class="source-title" href="https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/components#explore-the-directory" rel="external">https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/components#explore-the-directory</a></p>
</aside>
<span data-as="p">The explorer shows an example plugin, <code>my-plugin</code>, that has one of every kind of component in its default location:</span>
<ul>
<li>A review skill and an <code>about</code> command</li>
<li>A security-review subagent</li>
<li>A hook that formats files after Claude edits them, and the <code>scripts/</code> folder it calls</li>
<li>A log monitor</li>
<li>An output style and a color theme</li>
<li>A route-audit workflow</li>
<li>A <code>hello-plugin</code> executable</li>
<li>Default settings</li>
<li>A local MCP server and a Go language server</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">Each file is the smallest valid example of its format, there to show the shape rather than to be useful: a real skill or agent carries full instructions and often supporting files, and a real hook or monitor does real work. The sections after the explorer use the same files as their examples and link to fuller ones. Select a file or folder to read what it’s for, see what goes in it, and find the section that covers it.</span>
<!-- -->
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="add-each-kind-of-component"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#add-each-kind-of-component">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Add each kind of component</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">Each section below covers one kind of component: where its files go in the plugin, an example that validates, what the user sees once the plugin loads, and the manifest key that changes the default location. Add the ones your plugin needs; none is required.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="skills"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#skills">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer">Skills</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">A <a class="link" href="/docs/en/skills">skill</a> is a <code>SKILL.md</code> file that Claude can load when its description matches the task. The user can also run it as a command. Save each skill in its own directory under <code>skills/</code>:</span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">---</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">Review the changed files. Report style problems first, then missing tests.</span></span>

<span data-as="p">After you load the plugin, <code>/my-plugin:review</code> runs the skill. The command name and who can invoke it follow these rules:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Command name</strong>: <code>/&lt;plugin&gt;:&lt;directory&gt;</code>, so <code>skills/review/SKILL.md</code> in <code>my-plugin</code> is <code>/my-plugin:review</code>. If you set <code>name</code> in the frontmatter, it replaces the last segment and the plugin prefix stays. See <a class="link" href="/docs/en/skills#how-a-skill-gets-its-command-name">how a skill gets its command name</a></li>
<li><strong>Who invokes it</strong>: Claude, the user, or both, controlled by frontmatter. See <a class="link" href="/docs/en/skills#control-who-invokes-a-skill">Control who invokes a skill</a></li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">You can also place skills outside the default <code>skills/</code> directory:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Additional directories</strong>: list them in the <code>skills</code> manifest key. They add to the default <code>skills/</code> scan rather than replacing it, unlike <code>commands</code> and <code>agents</code></li>
<li><strong>A single skill at the plugin root</strong>: with no <code>skills/</code> directory and no <code>skills</code> manifest key, a <code>SKILL.md</code> at the plugin root loads as one skill. Set <code>name</code> in its frontmatter, because otherwise a marketplace install names the skill after its <a class="link" href="/docs/en/plugins/loading#find-plugins-on-disk">cache directory</a> rather than your plugin</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">To include instructions in a plugin, write them as a skill. Claude Code doesn’t load a <code>CLAUDE.md</code> at the plugin root, and <code>claude plugin validate</code> warns <code>CLAUDE.md at the plugin root is not loaded as project context</code>.</span>
<span data-as="p">If a rule must hold every time, such as <a class="link" href="/docs/en/hooks-guide#block-edits-to-protected-files">blocking edits to protected files</a>, add it to the plugin as a <a class="link" href="#hooks">hook</a> rather than a skill. To choose between the two, see the Hook vs Skill tab under <a class="link" href="/docs/en/features-overview#compare-similar-features">Compare similar features</a>.</span>
<span data-as="p">For frontmatter fields and supporting files, see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/skills">Skills</a>.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="commands"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#commands">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer">Commands</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">A command is a single Markdown file the user runs by name, such as <code>/my-plugin:about</code>.</span>
<div aria-label="Note" class="callout my-4 px-5 py-4 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl flex gap-3 border border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 dark:border-blue-900 dark:bg-blue-600/20" data-callout-type="note" role="note"><div class="mt-0.5 w-4" data-component-part="callout-icon"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-4 text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1.5" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path clip-rule="evenodd" d="M 9 1.6714 C 13.0371 1.6714 16.3286 4.9629 16.3286 9 C 16.3286 13.0371 13.0371 16.3286 9 16.3286 C 7.0574 16.3252 5.1953 15.552 3.8217 14.1783 C 2.448 12.8047 1.6748 10.9426 1.6714 9 C 1.6714 4.9629 4.9629 1.6714 9 1.6714 Z M 9 0 C 4.0371 0 0 4.0371 0 9 C 0 13.9629 4.0371 18 9 18 C 13.9629 18 18 13.9629 18 9 C 18 4.0371 13.9629 0 9 0 Z M 10.2857 3.8571 H 7.7143 V 10.2857 H 10.2857 V 3.8571 Z M 10.2857 11.5714 H 7.7143 V 14.1429 H 10.2857 V 11.5714 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-rule="evenodd" stroke="none"></path></svg></div><div class="text-sm prose dark:prose-invert min-w-0 w-full [&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-light dark:[&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-dark [&amp;_code]:text-current! [&amp;_kbd]:text-current! [&amp;_a]:text-current! [&amp;_a]:border-current [&amp;_strong]:text-current! text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300" data-component-part="callout-content"><span data-as="p">Commands are the older format, and <a class="link" href="#skills">skills</a> supersede them for new work. A skill runs by name the same way, and it can also carry supporting files in its directory. Keep <code>commands/</code> for files you’re moving over from <code>.claude/commands/</code>.</span></div></div>
<span data-as="p">Save a command at <code>commands/&lt;file&gt;.md</code> and it becomes <code>/&lt;plugin&gt;:&lt;file&gt;</code>. A subdirectory adds a segment, so <code>commands/db/migrate.md</code> is <code>/my-plugin:db:migrate</code>.</span>
<span data-as="p">Command files take the same frontmatter as skills.</span>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="define-commands-in-the-manifest"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#define-commands-in-the-manifest">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Define commands in the manifest</span></h4>
<span data-as="p">You only need this if you want to keep command files somewhere other than <code>commands/</code>, or to define a short command inside <code>plugin.json</code> without a separate Markdown file. Set the <code>commands</code> manifest key, and Claude Code reads it instead of scanning <code>commands/</code>. The key takes a path, an array of paths, or an object that maps each command name to either a <code>source</code> file or inline <code>content</code>.</span>

<span data-as="p">This agent is named <code>my-plugin:security-reviewer</code>, and the user can <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sub-agents#invoke-subagents-explicitly">invoke it explicitly</a> with <code>@agent-my-plugin:security-reviewer</code>. The name form is <code>&lt;plugin&gt;:&lt;name&gt;</code>, where <code>&lt;name&gt;</code> comes from the frontmatter <code>name</code> field, or from the file name when that field is missing.</span>
<span data-as="p">The <code>agents</code> manifest key replaces the <code>agents/</code> scan.</span>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="organize-agents-in-subfolders"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#organize-agents-in-subfolders">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Organize agents in subfolders</span></h4>
<span data-as="p">You can put plugin agent files in subfolders of <code>agents/</code>. Claude Code <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sub-agents#choose-the-subagent-scope">loads them recursively</a> and joins the plugin name, each subfolder name, and the file name with colons to form the agent’s scoped name. For example, <code>agents/review/security.md</code> in a plugin named <code>my-plugin</code> loads as <code>my-plugin:review:security</code>. Two settings change that name:</span>
<ul>
<li>Frontmatter <code>name</code>: it replaces only the file name, so <code>name: audit</code> in <code>agents/review/security.md</code> loads as <code>my-plugin:review:audit</code></li>
<li>Manifest <a class="link" href="/docs/en/plugins/manifest-reference#fields"><code>agents</code></a> field: a file you list there loads without subfolder names, so <code>"agents": "./custom/review/security.md"</code> loads as <code>my-plugin:security</code></li>
</ul>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="frontmatter-fields-in-plugin-agents"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#frontmatter-fields-in-plugin-agents">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Frontmatter fields in plugin agents</span></h4>
<span data-as="p">A plugin agent’s frontmatter follows these rules:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Supported fields</strong>: <code>name</code>, <code>description</code>, <code>model</code>, <code>effort</code>, <code>maxTurns</code>, <code>tools</code>, <code>disallowedTools</code>, <code>skills</code>, <code>memory</code>, <code>background</code>, <code>omitClaudeMd</code>, <code>isolation</code>, <code>color</code>, and the <code>cacheTtl</code> key of <code>experimental</code>. The only valid <code>isolation</code> value is <code>"worktree"</code>. See <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sub-agents#supported-frontmatter-fields">supported frontmatter fields</a> for what each one does</li>
<li><strong>Ignored fields</strong>: <code>permissionMode</code>, <code>hooks</code>, <code>mcpServers</code>, and <code>initialPrompt</code>. An agent file can’t add hooks or MCP servers on its own, so add those as plugin <a class="link" href="#hooks">hooks</a> and <a class="link" href="#mcp-servers">MCP servers</a> instead</li>
<li><strong>Frontmatter that doesn’t parse</strong>: the agent still loads with every field ignored. It’s named after the file, and its description reads <code>Agent from my-plugin plugin</code>. Run <a class="link" href="/docs/en/plugins/cli-reference#plugin-validate"><code>claude plugin validate</code></a> in your shell to find these files</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">For what each field does and the precedence rules, see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sub-agents#supported-frontmatter-fields">Subagents</a>.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="hooks"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#hooks">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer">Hooks</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">A <a class="link" href="/docs/en/hooks-guide">hook</a> runs something automatically at a point in Claude Code’s lifecycle, such as after every file edit: a shell command, an HTTP request, an MCP tool call, a prompt to a model, or a subagent. Save the plugin’s hooks in <code>hooks/hooks.json</code> at the plugin root, under a top-level <code>"hooks"</code> key, in the same shape as the <code>hooks</code> object in <code>settings.json</code>. That lets you copy an existing settings hook in unchanged.</span>
<span data-as="p">This hook runs a bundled script after every <code>Write</code> or <code>Edit</code>:</span>

<span data-as="p">Save the script at <code>scripts/format.sh</code> and make it executable.</span>
<span data-as="p">Load the plugin and ask Claude to edit a file. A <code>PostToolUse</code> hook that exits 0 shows nothing in the transcript, so confirm it ran with <a class="link" href="/docs/en/hooks#debug-hooks">debug logging</a> or by what the script itself changes.</span>
<span data-as="p">Hooks in <code>hooks/hooks.json</code> and in the <code>hooks</code> manifest key both load. For every event and its payload, see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/hooks#hook-events">Hook events</a>.</span>
<span data-as="p">To write hooks as JavaScript functions that run inside Claude Code and can draw in its interface, list a module file under a <code>modules</code> key in the same <code>hooks/hooks.json</code>. A plugin with one is a mod. See <a class="link" href="/docs/en/plugins/mods/create">Create a mod</a>.</span>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="when-plugin-hooks-fire"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#when-plugin-hooks-fire">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">When plugin hooks fire</span></h4>
<span data-as="p">A plugin’s hooks don’t wait for one of the plugin’s skills or commands to be used. Claude Code registers them when a session loads the plugin, and they fire on their events from then on. To limit when a hook runs, narrow its <code>matcher</code>.</span>
<span data-as="p">If a hook never fires, see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/plugins/troubleshooting#failed-to-load-hooks-from-and-hooks-that-dont-fire">hooks that don’t fire</a>.</span>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="environment-quoting-and-matching-mcp-tools"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#environment-quoting-and-matching-mcp-tools">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Environment, quoting, and matching MCP tools</span></h4>
<span data-as="p">The hook’s environment, the quoting of <code>${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}</code>, and matchers for the plugin’s own MCP tools work as follows:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Environment</strong>: every hook process receives <code>CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT</code> and <code>CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA</code> in its environment, plus <code>CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_&lt;KEY&gt;</code> for each <a class="link" href="#user-configuration">user configuration</a> value, so your script can read them from there</li>
<li><strong>Quoting</strong>: when <code>command</code> has no <code>args</code>, it runs through a shell, so wrap the <code>${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}</code> path in double quotes, as the <code>hooks/hooks.json</code> example under <a class="link" href="#hooks">Hooks</a> does, to keep the expanded path one shell word. When you pass <code>args</code> instead, each element is passed as one argument with no shell and needs no quoting. See <a class="link" href="/docs/en/hooks#exec-form-and-shell-form">exec form and shell form</a></li>
<li><strong>Matching the plugin’s own MCP tools</strong>: a tool from an <a class="link" href="#mcp-servers">MCP server this plugin declares</a> is named <code>mcp__plugin_&lt;plugin&gt;_&lt;server&gt;__&lt;tool&gt;</code>, so write that full name in the matcher. A matcher on the server name alone never fires. See <a class="link" href="/docs/en/hooks#match-mcp-tools">Match MCP tools</a></li>
</ul>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="mcp-servers"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#mcp-servers">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">MCP servers</span></h3>

Declare it in <code>.mcp.json</code> at the plugin root, in the same shape as a <a class="link" href="/docs/en/mcp#project-scope">project <code>.mcp.json</code></a>. <span data-as="p">You can also omit the <code>mcpServers</code> wrapper and put <code>db</code> at the top level of the file.</span>
<span data-as="p">Load the plugin and run <code>/mcp</code> to confirm the server appears as <code>plugin:my-plugin:db</code>.</span>
<span data-as="p"><code>claude plugin validate</code> checks <code>.mcp.json</code> and reports a server entry that Claude Code would drop at load time as an error. Requires Claude Code v2.1.281 or later.</span>
<span data-as="p">For where a bad entry shows up at load time, see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/plugins/troubleshooting#invalid-mcp-server-config-for-and-mcp-servers-that-dont-start">MCP servers that don’t start</a>.</span>
<span data-as="p">The <code>mcpServers</code> manifest key takes an inline server map, a path to a JSON file, or an array of those. When a manifest server has the same name as one in <code>.mcp.json</code>, the manifest server replaces it.</span>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="reach-users-on-claude-ai-and-cowork"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#reach-users-on-claude-ai-and-cowork">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Reach users on claude.ai and Cowork</span></h4>
<span data-as="p">A local stdio server, such as the <code>db</code> server under <a class="link" href="#mcp-servers">MCP servers</a>, runs in Claude Code and in a Cowork session that runs on your machine in the Claude Desktop app, but not on claude.ai. To reach users there too, reference a remote server by its <code>https://</code> URL, which claude.ai and Cowork offer to the user as a connector, as <a class="link" href="https://claude.com/docs/plugins/build#bundle-an-mcp-connector-with-its-skill" rel="noreferrer" target="_blank">Bundle an MCP connector with its skill</a> shows.</span>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="server-names-tool-names-and-reloads"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#server-names-tool-names-and-reloads">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Server names, tool names, and reloads</span></h4>
<span data-as="p">The server’s names, variable substitution, and reload behavior follow these rules:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Server name</strong>: <code>plugin:&lt;plugin&gt;:&lt;server&gt;</code>, so the <code>db</code> server in <code>my-plugin</code> is <code>plugin:my-plugin:db</code> in <code>/mcp</code>. Use the same form to name the server in an <a class="link" href="/docs/en/hooks#mcp-tool-hook-fields"><code>mcp_tool</code> hook</a></li>
<li><strong>Tool names</strong>: <code>mcp__plugin_&lt;plugin&gt;_&lt;server&gt;__&lt;tool&gt;</code>, so a <code>query</code> tool on that <code>db</code> server is <code>mcp__plugin_my-plugin_db__query</code>. That is the name to use in <a class="link" href="/docs/en/permissions">permission rules</a> and <a class="link" href="#hooks">hook matchers</a></li>
<li><strong>Substitution</strong>: <code>${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}</code> and the other <a class="link" href="#path-variables-and-persistent-data">path variables</a> are substituted in <code>command</code>, <code>args</code>, and <code>env</code>. No quoting is needed in <code>args</code>, because each element is passed as one argument</li>
<li><strong>Reload</strong>: when the user runs <code>/reload-plugins</code> and <a class="link" href="/docs/en/plugins/cli-reference#reloads-that-change-mcp-tools">the reload applies</a>, a server whose configuration is unchanged keeps its connection. A server whose configuration changed reconnects, and one you removed disconnects</li>
</ul>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="include-a-packaged-mcpb-server"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#include-a-packaged-mcpb-server">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Include a packaged MCPB server</span></h4>
<span data-as="p">The <code>mcpServers</code> key also accepts a packaged server as an <a class="link" href="https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/mcpb" rel="noreferrer" target="_blank">MCPB file</a>, whose extension is <code>.mcpb</code> or the older <code>.dxt</code>. Point the key at the file, as a path inside the plugin or an <code>https://</code> URL:</span>

<span data-as="p">The server takes its name from the <code>name</code> in the bundle’s manifest.</span>
<span data-as="p">A bundle’s own manifest can declare settings the server needs from the user in a <code>user_config</code> block. A bundled server with a required setting that has no saved value doesn’t start. The <code>/plugin</code> <strong>Errors</strong> tab shows <code>Bundled MCP server "&lt;name&gt;" was not started: it needs configuration</code>.</span>
<span data-as="p">Users supply the values in one of two ways:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>In <code>/plugin</code></strong>: select the plugin on the <strong>Installed</strong> tab and choose <strong>Configure</strong></li>
<li><strong>At install, from the shell</strong>: pass <a class="link" href="/docs/en/plugins/cli-reference#plugin-install"><code>--config &lt;server&gt;.&lt;key&gt;=&lt;value&gt;</code></a> to <code>claude plugin install</code>. Requires Claude Code v2.1.285 or later, and works only for a bundle packaged inside the plugin.</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">For transports and authentication, see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/mcp#plugin-provided-mcp-servers">MCP</a>.</span>

<span data-as="p">The file maps each server name directly to its configuration, with no wrapper object around the map. <code>command</code> is the binary’s name, with its arguments in <code>args</code>. <code>extensionToLanguage</code> needs at least one extension, each starting with <code>.</code>.</span>
<span data-as="p"><code>claude plugin validate</code> doesn’t read this file. When any entry is invalid, the whole file is skipped at load and <code>Invalid LSP server config for ".lsp.json"</code> appears in the <code>/plugin</code> <strong>Errors</strong> tab.</span>
<span data-as="p">Your plugin configures the connection but doesn’t install the server binary, and each file extension gets one server:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Missing binary</strong>: Claude Code starts <code>command</code> by name from the user’s <code>PATH</code>. When the binary isn’t there, the server fails to start and <code>claude --debug</code> logs <code>LSP server &lt;name&gt; failed to start</code></li>
<li><strong>Extension conflicts</strong>: when two enabled servers claim the same extension, the first registered handles those files and the other isn’t used for them, whether the servers come from one plugin or two. The <code>/plugin</code> <strong>Errors</strong> tab shows the warning <code>LSP server "&lt;name&gt;" is not used for &lt;ext&gt; files</code></li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">The <code>lspServers</code> manifest key takes the same map inline, a path to a JSON file, or an array of those, and its servers add to the ones in <code>.lsp.json</code>. When a manifest server has the same name as one in <code>.lsp.json</code>, the manifest server replaces it.</span>
<span data-as="p">For <code>transport</code>, timeouts, restarts, and the other fields, see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/plugins/manifest-reference#lspservers"><code>lspServers</code></a>.</span>
<span data-as="p">Send log output to stderr, not stdout. Claude Code reads a server’s stdout as protocol messages only, and accepts message headers up to 64 KiB and a message body up to 32 MiB.</span>
<span data-as="p">Claude Code disconnects a server that exceeds either limit or writes non-protocol output to stdout, and counts the disconnect as a crash for <code>restartOnCrash</code> and <code>maxRestarts</code>. When you run with <code>--debug</code>, Claude Code writes an error naming the cause to the debug log.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="executables"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#executables">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer">Executables</span></h3>

<span data-as="p">Make it executable with <code>chmod +x bin/hello-plugin</code> and load the plugin. When you ask Claude to run <code>hello-plugin</code>, the Bash tool result shows the script’s output.</span>
<span data-as="p">Plugin <code>bin/</code> directories come after the user’s own <code>PATH</code> entries, so a plugin can’t shadow <code>git</code>, <code>ls</code>, or another system command.</span>
<span data-as="p">claude.ai and Cowork don’t install a plugin that has a top-level <code>bin/</code> directory, including one you <a class="link" href="https://claude.com/docs/plugins/org-sync#keep-executables-out-of-the-top-level-bin-directory" rel="noreferrer" target="_blank">distribute through claude.ai organization settings</a>.</span>

<span data-as="p">To set defaults that apply while the plugin is enabled, add a <code>settings.json</code> at the plugin root, or put the same object inline in the <code>settings</code> manifest key. Two keys take effect, <code>agent</code> and <code>subagentStatusLine</code>, and every other key is dropped.</span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">}</span></span>
</code></pre></div></div></div></div><div aria-hidden="true" class="code-block-fade-overlay print:hidden" data-fade-overlay="true" style="--fade-color-light:#ffffff;--fade-color-dark:#0B0C0E"></div></div>
<span data-as="p">Load the plugin and start a session. Claude then answers in the main conversation with the <code>security-reviewer</code> agent’s system prompt and model.</span>
<span data-as="p">For everything the key controls, see the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference#agent"><code>agent</code> setting</a>.</span>
<span data-as="p">When the same key is set in more than one place, these rules decide which value applies:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>File over manifest</strong>: when both exist and <code>settings.json</code> sets at least one supported key, <code>settings.json</code> applies and the manifest’s <code>settings</code> is ignored</li>
<li><strong>User settings over plugin defaults</strong>: across settings sources, plugin defaults are the lowest layer, so a user’s own <code>agent</code> in <code>~/.claude/settings.json</code> overrides yours</li>
<li><strong>Two plugins set the same key</strong>: the value from the plugin loaded last applies, and <code>claude --debug</code> logs <code>overrides setting</code></li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">For the <code>subagentStatusLine</code> shape, see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/statusline#subagent-status-lines">subagent status lines</a>.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="themes-and-output-styles"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#themes-and-output-styles">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Themes and output styles</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">A plugin can include color themes and output styles. Both appear in the same pickers as the user’s own. For either one, setting the manifest key replaces the folder scan.</span>

<span data-as="p">A <a class="link" href="/docs/en/channels">channel</a> lets an outside system such as a chat app send messages into a session. In a plugin, a channel is one of the MCP servers plus a <code>channels</code> entry that binds to it and can prompt for its own configuration. This manifest binds a channel to a <code>telegram</code> server and asks for a bot token:</span>

<span data-as="p">The command runs in a shell, in the session’s current working directory. It runs with your full user permissions and outside the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sandboxing">sandbox</a>.</span>
<span data-as="p">A monitor’s command is limited in where it starts and what it can reference:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Interactive sessions only</strong>: plugin monitors start in an interactive session and never in non-interactive mode with the <code>-p</code> flag. They also don’t start in sessions where the API provider or telemetry settings make the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/tools-reference#monitor-tool">Monitor tool</a> unavailable</li>
<li><strong>No user configuration</strong>: <code>command</code> gets the <a class="link" href="#path-variables-and-persistent-data">path variables</a> and <code>${ENV_VAR}</code> from the environment, but never <code>${user_config.*}</code>. A monitor that references one doesn’t start, and monitor processes don’t receive <code>CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_&lt;KEY&gt;</code> either</li>
<li><strong>Disabling mid-session</strong>: if you disable a plugin mid-session, Claude Code doesn’t stop monitors that are already running. They stop when the session ends</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">The <code>experimental.monitors</code> manifest key takes the same array inline or a path to a JSON file, and is read instead of <code>monitors/monitors.json</code>.</span>
<span data-as="p">For the <code>when</code> trigger and the other fields, see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/plugins/manifest-reference#monitors"><code>monitors</code></a>.</span>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="user-configuration"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#user-configuration">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Ask the user for configuration values</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">Declare the values your plugin needs from the user in the <code>userConfig</code> manifest key, so users don’t edit <code>settings.json</code> themselves. Each option appears in a dialog with its <code>title</code> as the label and its <code>description</code> beneath it.</span>
<span data-as="p">Set <code>"sensitive": true</code> for a token or password. The dialog then masks the input, and the value is stored in secure storage rather than <code>settings.json</code>.</span>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="when-the-configuration-dialog-appears"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#when-the-configuration-dialog-appears">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">When the configuration dialog appears</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">The dialog is part of the interactive <code>/plugin</code> interface. When the user does any of the following, it opens for any option that isn’t set yet:</span>
<ul>
<li>Installs the plugin in <code>/plugin</code></li>
<li>Runs <code>/plugin install &lt;plugin&gt;@&lt;marketplace&gt;</code> inside a session</li>
<li>Enables the plugin from the <strong>Installed</strong> tab in <code>/plugin</code></li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">To open the same dialog at any time, the user runs <code>/plugin configure &lt;plugin&gt;@&lt;marketplace&gt;</code>.</span>
<span data-as="p">The VS Code extension’s <a class="link" href="/docs/en/vs-code#install-plugins">Manage plugins dialog</a> asks for unset options as a form after an install, and a gear icon on the plugin’s row opens the form again with every option.</span>
<span data-as="p">The <code>claude plugin install</code> shell command never prompts for <code>userConfig</code> values. To set values from the shell, pass each one as <code>--config KEY=VALUE</code> when you install, or pipe a JSON object to <a class="link" href="/docs/en/plugins/cli-reference#plugin-configure"><code>claude plugin configure --values-stdin</code></a> afterward.</span>
<span data-as="p">When options remain unset, <code>claude plugin install</code> prints a <code>userConfig options not yet set</code> line. For the line’s exact text, see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/plugins/troubleshooting#the-userconfig-dialog-never-appears">The <code>userConfig</code> dialog never appears</a>.</span>
<span data-as="p">For the option fields, where each value is stored, how a component references a saved value, and which fields reject <code>${user_config.*}</code>, see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/plugins/manifest-reference#user-configuration">User configuration</a>.</span>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="path-variables-and-persistent-data"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#path-variables-and-persistent-data">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Reference plugin paths and store data</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">You don’t know where your plugin will be installed, so refer to its files and data through these variables rather than fixed paths. They’re substituted in skill, command, and agent content, in hook and monitor commands, and in MCP and LSP server configurations. They’re also exported to hook, MCP, and LSP processes:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong><code>${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}</code></strong>: the plugin’s install directory. Each version has its own <a class="link" href="/docs/en/plugins/loading#find-plugins-on-disk">cache directory</a>, so the path changes when the plugin updates. Don’t write state there</li>
<li><strong><code>${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}</code></strong>: a directory that survives updates, for <code>node_modules</code>, virtual environments, and caches. It resolves to <code>~/.claude/plugins/data/&lt;id&gt;/</code> and is created when first referenced</li>
<li><strong><code>${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}</code></strong>: the project root, the same value hooks receive</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">In the data directory path, <code>&lt;id&gt;</code> is the plugin identifier with every character other than letters, digits, <code>_</code>, and <code>-</code> replaced by <code>-</code>, so <code>my-plugin@my-marketplace</code> becomes <code>my-plugin-my-marketplace</code>.</span>
<span data-as="p">On Windows, the substituted paths use forward slashes so a shell doesn’t read backslashes as escapes.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="install-dependencies-into-the-data-directory"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#install-dependencies-into-the-data-directory">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Install dependencies into the data directory</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">For a marketplace-installed plugin, Claude Code installs eligible <a class="link" href="/docs/en/plugins/loading#node-js-package-dependencies">Node.js package dependencies</a> automatically when it caches the plugin, so you may not need to install them yourself. When you do, this <code>SessionStart</code> hook installs <code>node_modules</code> into <code>${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}</code> on first run and again after an update changes <code>package.json</code>:</span>

<span data-as="p">After the first session, <code>~/.claude/plugins/data/&lt;id&gt;/node_modules</code> exists.
